title: Unexpected behaviors between `Input.is_action_just_pressed()` and `Input.get_action_length()`
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: 4.5.1stable ### System information Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7628) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-12490F (12 threads) - 31.81 GiB memory ### Issue description I am creating a cursor movement that is sensitive to input in all axis. I have found that in physical processes, unexpected behavior occurs between `Input.is_action_just_pressed()` and `Input.get_action_length()`, such as if a certain frame `Input.is_action_just_pressed()` return true, ideally I would like to obtain the `Input.get_action_length()` of that frame(non-zero value), but the result often exceeds my expectations. Often, it appears that `Input.is_action_just_pressed()` is true while `Input.get_action_length()` is 0.0, or `Input.is_action_just_pressed()` is false while `Input.get_action_length()` is 1.0. This makes me very confused. This unexpected behavior often appears in the first frame and occasionally occurs at other times, but it is difficult to reproduce. Screenshot: Demo[at first frame]: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/10e732f8-355b-4919-aba4-c1aeaa881277 ### Steps to reproduce Run the MRP, just quickly press `ui_left` after run the scene, then check the results.(is easily to reproduce at first frame, it also occasionally occurs at other times, but hard to reproduce) ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [input_2025-11-01_18-40-46.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23282275/input_2025-11-01_18-40-46.zip)
